group_manifest.proof_strategy: Instantiate dispatch head/list with the caller's values. The sentinel proof reduces dispatch at anchor=head. The member proof derives that the sentinel is absent from the abstract nodes, rules out anchor=head, and reduces dispatch to insert_after_nodes. In both cases apply sepcon adjunction and discharge a reflexive wand while framing the original resources.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: In anchor nodes -> ~ In head nodes -> dispatch_nodes head nodes anchor inserted = insert_after_nodes nodes anchor inserted

likely_helper_declarations: One pure dispatch-reduction lemma above; derive xizi_dll head-not-in-nodes as a proof-local spatial induction.
group_entry.proof_strategy: Instantiate dispatch head/list with the caller's values. The sentinel proof reduces dispatch at anchor=head. The member proof derives that the sentinel is absent from the abstract nodes, rules out anchor=head, and reduces dispatch to insert_after_nodes. In both cases apply sepcon adjunction and discharge a reflexive wand while framing the original resources.
group_entry.natural_language_proof_strategy: Prove the shared existential-and-wand skeleton once conceptually; handle the sentinel branch by reflexivity and the member branch by the dll-derived sentinel-absence fact plus the pure dispatch helper.

premise_discharge.sentinel_anchor: right side of anchor proposition by reflexivity
premise_discharge.member_anchor: left side from the explicit In premise
premise_discharge.anchor_not_head: explicit In plus dll-derived ~ In head nodes
premise_discharge.wand: antecedent and consequent coincide after dispatch reduction

group_entry.grouping_reason: Both witnesses are public-contract derivations using existential instantiation and wand adjunction, a distinct strategy from the five implementation-shape VCs.
